prompt:
Create a new raster game icon sheet, six clean storybook game icons for children.
Attached robot is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for friendly rounded forms, smooth cel shading and THIN dark-navy outlines. Do not draw its character or any letters from the reference.

COMPOSITION: 1536x1024 landscape, invisible 3 columns x 2 rows of equal 512px square cells. Reading order as below. Center each complete icon group in its cell; longest extent ~384px (75% of cell), with at least 64px empty margin on every side. No part crosses a cell boundary. Same apparent icon scale, same gentle three-quarter front view showing front and right side. No grid lines.
BACKGROUND: real fully transparent alpha outside objects. No painted background, no floor, no cast shadows, no halos, no glows or vignette.
STYLE: THIN clean even dark-navy outline ~2px at this canvas size, never bold sticker borders. Rounded simple instantly recognizable silhouettes. Flat uniform base fills plus exactly one discrete soft shadow tone and one small solid highlight shape per color/material. Smooth glossy cel shading using solid shapes only. No gradients, texture, grain, patchiness, washed-out regions or realistic reflections.
PALETTE: cream/white main bodies, only one or two accent hues per item from teal, coral, sunny yellow, sky blue. Dark navy outlines, wheels, rotors and windows if needed. Green leaves and sprouts and coral-red apple are specifically required natural-color exceptions. Keep these restrained. No text, no letters, no digits, no AI, no logos. Screens at most one simple pictogram. Small details few. No people.

TOP LEFT / 1 SELF-DRIVING CAR: small rounded cream compact car, teal roof sensor as a small cylindrical puck, dark navy tires, simple dark window surfaces, a few clean details. Empty, no road or effects.
TOP CENTER / 2 DELIVERY ROBOT: small white box-shaped autonomous delivery robot on four simple little wheels, visibly carrying one small cream parcel secured on top with a sunny-yellow tape band. Teal sensor. No writing or barcode on parcel.
TOP RIGHT / 3 DRONE TAXI: white passenger drone cabin pod with one large simple cockpit window, four clearly separate rotors on four short arms, sunny-yellow stripe around cabin. Exactly four rotors, visible and countable, gentle 3/4 view, compact shape, no motion streaks.
BOTTOM LEFT / 4 PEST-DETECTING DRONE: small simple white quadcopter hovering above one large green leaf. Tiny dark navy bug on leaf with a small coral corner bracket around just the bug. Whole drone + leaf group compact, centered, contained in cell. No scan rays, no extra decorations.
BOTTOM CENTER / 5 HARVEST ROBOT: white articulated robot arm mounted on a compact cream base, teal two-finger gripper gently grasping a coral-red apple still on a short simple branch with one green leaf. No humanoid head or body. Recognizable mechanical harvesting arm. Show connection from base through joints to gripper. Only a short branch segment, no full tree or background.
BOTTOM RIGHT / 6 GREENHOUSE CONTROLLER: small glass greenhouse, cream structural frame, pale sky-blue translucent-looking panes rendered as flat color, inside two simple green sprouts, little cream control box attached beside door. Control box has one small teal leaf pictogram. No other interface marks. Minimal clean greenhouse with pitched roof, clear recognizable silhouette.

Six full unclipped groups, same thin outline weight throughout. Exactly 3 across and 2 down, clean transparent margins.
